mapper.sql: select menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, menu_path, NULL as component, CASE WHEN keep_alive = 1 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END as is_cache, CAST(menu_type AS CHAR) as menu_type, hidden, status, is_del, ifnull(perms,'') as perms, icon, create_time from sys_menu
mapper.select: where is_del = 0 order by parent_id, order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, NULL as component, CASE WHEN m.keep_alive = 1 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END as is_cache, CAST(m.menu_type AS CHAR) as menu_type, m.hidden, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time from sys_menu m where m.menu_type in ('0', '1', '3') and m.status = 0 and m.is_del = '0' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, NULL as component, CASE WHEN m.keep_alive = 1 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END as is_cache, CAST(m.menu_type AS CHAR) as menu_type, m.hidden, m.status, ifnull(m.perms,'') as perms, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role ro on ur.role_id = ro.role_id left join sys_user u on ur.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('0', '1', '3') and m.status = 0 and m.is_del = '0' AND ro.status = 0 and ro.is_del = '0' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num

select m.menu_id from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.is_del = '0'
and m.menu_id not in (select m.parent_id from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and rm.role_id = #{roleId} where m.is_del = '0')
order by m.parent_id, m.order_num
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where m.is_del = '0'

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where m.status = '0' and m.is_del = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.is_del = '0' and ur.user_id = #{userId}
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where m.status = '0' and m.is_del = '0' and rm.role_id = #{roleId}
select count(1) from sys_menu where parent_id = #{menuId} and is_del = '0'
where menu_name= #{menuName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and is_del = '0' limit 1
where menu_type in ('0', '1', '3') and is_del = '0' and menu_path = #{path}
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_menu( menu_id, menu_name, menu_path, parent_id, menu_type, order_num, hidden, keep_alive, status, is_del, perms, icon, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time )values( #{menuId}, #{menuName},
#{path}, '',
#{parentId}, 0,
#{menuType}, 0,
#{orderNum}, 0,
#{visible}, 0,
1, 0, 1,
#{status}, 0,
'0', #{perms}, #{icon},
#{createBy}, 'admin',
#{updateBy}, #{createBy}, 'admin',
sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_menu set order_num = #{orderNum} where menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.delete: update sys_menu set is_del = '1', update_time = sysdate() where menu_id = #{menuId}
